f.title: Prepare for GVP implementation and start PV activities with reference to the GVP
f.statement: Before the GVP takes effect, MAHs and sponsors (applicants approved to conduct clinical trials) shall prepare carefully: take part in training and exchanges, learn the core content and specific requirements of the GVP, begin establishing and improving their pharmacovigilance system, and carry out pharmacovigilance activities with reference to the GVP requirements.
f.clause: 二、自规范发布至施行期间持有人和申办者如何开展相关工作 (Q2)
f.applicability: China; NMPA Center for Drug Reevaluation Q&A on the GVP (药物警戒质量管理规范)

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder and sponsor (申办者)
rows.quote: 药品上市许可持有人（以下简称“持有人”）和获准开展药物临床试验的药品注册申请人（以下简称“申办者”）应当认真做好规范施行前的准备工作，积极参加相关培训和交流，学习和掌握规范的核心要义及具体内容，着手建立健全药物警戒体系，并参照规范要求开展药物警戒活动。
rows.location: 二、自规范发布至施行期间持有人和申办者如何开展相关工作 (Q2)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and any time limit; statement adds nothing. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor; level follows the Chinese modal (应当/应 = Mandatory, 可以/可 = Permitted, 需要关注 = Recommended).
rows.quote_en: Drug marketing authorisation holders ("holders") and drug registration applicants approved to conduct clinical trials ("sponsors") shall carefully prepare for the implementation of the GVP, actively participate in relevant training and exchanges, learn and master the core essence and specific content of the GVP, set about establishing and improving their pharmacovigilance system, and carry out pharmacovigilance activities with reference to the GVP requirements.

f.title: Follow the GVP where other documents conflict, from its effective date
f.statement: Where other relevant regulatory documents are inconsistent with the GVP, the GVP requirements apply from the date the GVP formally takes effect.
f.clause: 四、新旧法规文件的相关要求如何衔接 (Q4)
f.applicability: China; NMPA Center for Drug Reevaluation Q&A on the GVP (药物警戒质量管理规范)

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (持有人) and sponsor
rows.quote: 其他相关法规文件与规范不一致的，自规范正式施行之日起，按照规范的要求执行。
rows.location: 四、新旧法规文件的相关要求如何衔接 (Q4)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and any time limit; statement adds nothing. Actor inferred (the rule applies to all parties bound by the GVP). Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor; level follows the Chinese modal (应当/应 = Mandatory, 可以/可 = Permitted, 需要关注 = Recommended).
rows.quote_en: Where other relevant regulatory documents are inconsistent with the GVP, from the date the GVP formally takes effect, the GVP requirements shall be followed.

f.title: Register in the national ADR monitoring system within 60 days
f.statement: MAHs shall complete information registration in the national adverse drug reaction monitoring system. Holders already registered in the MAH ADR direct reporting system need not re-register; those not yet registered shall register within 60 days from the date the announcement was published.
f.clause: 五、关于在国家药品不良反应监测系统中注册的问题 (Q5)
f.applicability: China; NMPA Center for Drug Reevaluation Q&A on the GVP (药物警戒质量管理规范)
f.exceptions: Holders already registered in the direct reporting system need not re-register.
f.systems: National ADR monitoring system; MAH ADR direct reporting system (daers.adrs.org.cn)

rows.deadline: Within 60 days of publication of the GVP announcement (NMPA Announcement 2021 No. 65)
rows.quote: 持有人应当在国家药品不良反应监测系统中完成信息注册。对于已经在国家药品不良反应监测系统的“药品上市许可持有人药品不良反应直接报告系统”（以下简称“直报系统”）中注册的，持有人无需重新注册；仍未注册的，应当自公告发布之日起 60日内注册。

rows.quote_en: Holders shall complete information registration in the national adverse drug reaction monitoring system. Holders already registered in the "MAH ADR direct reporting system" ("direct reporting system") of the national ADR monitoring system do not need to register again; those not yet registered shall register within 60 days from the date the announcement was published.

deadline_rule.applies_to: MAHs not yet registered in the direct reporting system

f.title: Update registration and product information within 30 days of a change
f.statement: Where user registration information or product information changes, the MAH shall update it in the system within 30 days from the date of the change.
